chapter.tac_rogue.1.title: §6Chapter 1: The Discovery
chapter.tac_rogue.1.summary: A dimensional rift appeared in the underground facility. Unknown hostiles emerging.
chapter.tac_rogue.1.background: Sensors under the old research wing detected heat and motion that did not match any known cavern. The first recon feed came back buried under static.
chapter.tac_rogue.2.title: §6Chapter 2: First Contact
chapter.tac_rogue.2.summary: First large-scale engagement with rift entities. Gain combat experience.
chapter.tac_rogue.2.background: Rift entities move in packs and react to light and gunfire. The objective is not heroics; learn engagement ranges and exit routes.
chapter.tac_rogue.3.title: §6Chapter 3: Marksman Training
chapter.tac_rogue.3.summary: HQ directive: Improve headshot accuracy immediately.
chapter.tac_rogue.3.background: Ammunition burn is exceeding supply forecasts. Operators who can hit weak points are the ones who still have rounds in the deep floors.
chapter.tac_rogue.4.title: §6Chapter 4: Shadow Operations
chapter.tac_rogue.4.summary: Infiltration mission. Eliminate targets without being detected.
chapter.tac_rogue.4.background: The rift now fields alert units. A straight fight can be won, but the next room punishes every wasted round.
chapter.tac_rogue.5.title: §6Chapter 5: Fortress Breach
chapter.tac_rogue.5.summary: Massive hostiles detected deep in the rift. Neutralize the bosses.
chapter.tac_rogue.5.background: A large signature has stabilized at the end of the fifth-floor block. It looks less like a mutation and more like a gatekeeper.
chapter.tac_rogue.6.title: §6Chapter 6: Iron Shield
chapter.tac_rogue.6.summary: Clear a floor with zero damage taken. Prove your defensive mastery.
chapter.tac_rogue.6.background: Deep-floor injuries drain medical supplies fast. Move before you are hit, and sometimes choose not to shoot if it keeps you alive.
chapter.tac_rogue.7.title: §6Chapter 7: War Chest
chapter.tac_rogue.7.summary: Operations running low on funds. Secure the supply line.
chapter.tac_rogue.7.background: The base supply line is unstable. Learn what to loot, what to sell, and what is actually worth carrying home.
chapter.tac_rogue.8.title: §6Chapter 8: Blitzkrieg
chapter.tac_rogue.8.summary: Secure the floor before enemy reinforcements arrive. Speed is everything.
chapter.tac_rogue.8.background: The longer you stay, the denser the rift response becomes. Fast clears are not style points; they are survival math.
chapter.tac_rogue.9.title: §6Chapter 9: Endurance
chapter.tac_rogue.9.background: Sustainment trials begin here. A flashy weapon matters less than a loadout that can keep firing when the floor gets quiet.
chapter.tac_rogue.10.title: §eChapter 10: Heart of the Rift
chapter.tac_rogue.10.summary: Reached the rift core. Powerful boss swarm awaits.
chapter.tac_rogue.10.background: Space is pulsing near the tenth-floor core. Hostiles are no longer acting like creatures; they are moving like part of a defense system.
chapter.tac_rogue.11.title: §6Chapter 11: Weapons Research
chapter.tac_rogue.11.summary: Collecting combat data. Varied weapon usage required.
chapter.tac_rogue.11.background: One weapon platform will not answer every threat. Recoil, reloads, attachments, and ammo behavior all need live-fire data.
chapter.tac_rogue.12.title: §6Chapter 12: Path of the Sniper
chapter.tac_rogue.12.background: In poor visibility, the side that sees first usually wins. Remove targets at range and the close fights become slightly less cruel.
chapter.tac_rogue.13.title: §6Chapter 13: The Assassin
chapter.tac_rogue.13.summary: High-difficulty stealth operations. Make no sound.
chapter.tac_rogue.13.background: The alert network is more sensitive now. Kill order, sightlines, and movement noise all matter.
chapter.tac_rogue.14.title: §6Chapter 14: Annihilation
chapter.tac_rogue.14.summary: Mass hostile surge from the rift. Eliminate all targets.
chapter.tac_rogue.14.background: Enemy numbers are starting to crush quality. If your clear speed falls behind, even good gear gets surrounded.
chapter.tac_rogue.15.title: §cChapter 15: Abyssal Guardians
chapter.tac_rogue.15.summary: Deepest rift zone. Defeat the endless stream of bosses.
chapter.tac_rogue.15.background: Guardian-class signatures are chaining together. From here, you are not just clearing floors; the rift is trying to wear you down.
chapter.tac_rogue.16.title: §6Chapter 16: The Perfect Soldier
chapter.tac_rogue.16.summary: Consecutive no-damage clears. Surpass your limits.
chapter.tac_rogue.16.background: Attrition-based clears are reaching their limit. Positioning, suppression, and clean decisions matter more than raw armor.
chapter.tac_rogue.17.title: §6Chapter 17: Purification
chapter.tac_rogue.17.background: Rift contamination is bleeding back into secured zones. Leaving stragglers alive slowly eats the base perimeter.
chapter.tac_rogue.18.title: §6Chapter 18: Race Against Time
chapter.tac_rogue.18.summary: Complete all missions before the rift collapses.
chapter.tac_rogue.18.background: The stable window is shrinking. Slow clears are not just inefficient; they can erase the route home.
chapter.tac_rogue.19.title: §cChapter 19: Final Advance
chapter.tac_rogue.19.summary: Assault into the other side of the rift. Deploy all forces.
chapter.tac_rogue.19.background: Observation teams found artificial structures beyond the rift. Hostiles may not be emerging by accident; they may be deployed.
chapter.tac_rogue.20.title: §4Chapter 20: The Final Rift
chapter.tac_rogue.20.summary: Close all rifts and save the world. The final battle.
chapter.tac_rogue.20.background: The final order is simple: destroy the core and close the rift. Simple orders are usually the worst ones.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.title: NPC Menu
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.commander.name: Col. Graves
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.commander.body.0: Chapter orders, candidate tasks, clear conditions. Check them before deployment.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.commander.body.1: Operations are selection-based. The field is not kind enough to make every pick easy.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.commander.body.2: Story task is mandatory. Select three side tasks and they stay locked.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.commander.body.3: Read the report. Operators who skip it tend to repeat the same mistake.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.quartermaster.bod: Weapons, ammo, and bad spending habits.
Guns, ammo, spares. Buy what keeps you alive, not just what looks clean.
Strong weapons cost more to feed. Watch your wallet and your magazines.
Check attachment compatibility. Wrong parts are just cargo.
Supply is boring, and half the deaths start with boring shortages.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.intel.name: Lt. Hayes
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.intel.body.0: Reached floors, HUD, popups, keybinds. Set your interface before you step out.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.intel.body.1: Only the current five-floor block advances clear quests. Past blocks are practice and recovery.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.intel.body.2: Intel is not flashy. Still better than walking in blind.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.intel.body.3: Extraction calls are part of the plan. Losing gear to pride is inefficient.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.medic.name: Doc Rivera
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.medic.body: Still standing? Fine. I can patch that.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.medic.body.0: Treatment, fatigue, critical entry. Your body is more honest than the logs.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.medic.body.1: Do not relax just because HP looks fine. Stamina collapse gets operators killed.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.medic.body.2: Critical entry limits healing above 35%. Unpleasant, but intentional.
gui.tac_rogue.npc_menu.medic.body.3: I can fix the wound. Not repeating the mistake is your job.

gui.tac_rogue.welcome.title: Welcome to TacZ: Rogue Protocol
gui.tac_rogue.welcome.tut3:
Crawling makes you completely invisible to
distant enemies.
gui.tac_rogue.welcome.tut5:
Keep an eye on the stamina gauge.
Sprinting or jumping consumes it.
gui.tac_rogue.welcome.tut7:
Some floors are entirely dark.
Use your flashlight to navigate!
gui.tac_rogue.welcome.tut9: When enemies remain, the compass beside the custom hotbar points toward the nearest enemy and shows the remaining count. It only gives direction, not coordinates or wall vision.
gui.tac_rogue.welcome.tut10: When stamina is running low, a fatigue icon appears near the crosshair as an early warning.
gui.tac_rogue.welcome.tut12: Review quests at Commander, then prepare weapons and ammo at Quartermaster before deployment. Deep Operations opens later as high-pressure progression.
gui.tac_rogue.welcome.tut14: Both first and third person are supported. Third-person gun crosshair moves to the predicted impact point, and the obstruction marker appears only when a wall blocks the camera-to-impact line.
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.lobby.title: Lobby terminals
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.lobby.body: Start at Commander and review quests. Picking operations keeps the run from becoming pure busywork. Mostly.
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.loadout.title: Loadout check
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.loadout.body: Use Quartermaster to check weapons, ammo, and recovery items. Running dry is a very dull way to lose.
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.perspective.title: Perspective choice
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.perspective.body: You can play in first or third person. Use F5 and the shoulder camera toggle to settle on the view that works.
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.crosshair.title: Third-person crosshair
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.crosshair.body: Third-person gun crosshair follows the predicted impact point. Orange corner marks warn that a wall blocks the camera-to-impact line.
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.stealth.title: Stealth and takedowns
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.stealth.body: Sneak or crawl to reduce pre-detection range. If you can drop an unaware enemy from behind, it is quieter than announcing yourself.
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.sound.title: Noise alert
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.sound.body: Gunshots, repeated fire, and ally hits can push enemies from investigation into combat. Suppressors reduce response range; they do not erase sound.
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.clear.title: After floor clear
hud.tac_rogue.tutorial.clear.body: After control, check perks, rerolls, shop restock, and the next floor. Gold does nothing by sitting there.

gui.tac_rogue.deep.title: Deep Operations
gui.tac_rogue.deep.cache.body: Spend Deep Core on a special cache. It rolls RARE+ weapons, useful attachments, or survival supplies for deep-floor runs.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.cache.pool: Pool: deep modified weapons, attachments, medkits, armor plates. Black Market increases the high-value roll bias.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.modifier.no_gun: Select a TacZ gun from your inventory.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.modifier.reforge.desc: Rerolls the selected weapon's Deep Modifier. Locked modifiers cannot be rerolled.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.modifier.lock.desc: Locks the selected weapon's current Modifier so later reforges keep it.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.modifier.extract.desc: Consumes the selected modified weapon and creates a Modifier Token.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.modifier.infuse.desc: Applies the selected Modifier Token to the selected RARE+ weapon. Offhand is not used.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.modifier.dismantle.de: Dismantles an EPIC or LEGENDARY weapon for Deep Core.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.prestige.body: Prestige resets the current run, normal perks, and carried gold, but keeps stash, Deep Core, highest floor, and permanent upgrades.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.info.0: Deep Core comes from 101+ band clears, deep bosses, deep tasks, and dismantling EPIC/LEGENDARY weapons.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.info.1: Deep Cache is a paid supply roll for RARE+ weapons, attachments, and survival items.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.info.2: BREACH improves boss and armored target damage.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.info.3: SUSTAIN restores a little HP and stamina on kills.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.info.4: OVERLOAD increases fire rate but makes control harsher.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.info.5: SCAVENGE can preserve or recover ammo on kills.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.info.6: FOCUS improves headshots and their small payout.
gui.tac_rogue.deep.info.7: Prestige keeps stash, Deep Core, highest floor, and permanent upgrades, sets carried gold to 0, then sends the operation back to Floor 1.

message.tac_rogue.deep_same_slot: Weapon and token must be different slots.
message.tac_rogue.deep_terminal_required: Use Deep Operations near Intel or Quartermaster in the lobby.
message.tac_rogue.deep_dismantle_need: Only EPIC or LEGENDARY guns can be dismantled for Deep Core.
message.tac_rogue.deep_boss_first: Deep boss first clear. Deep Core +%s.
message.tac_rogue.first_prestige_cache: Prestige Initiation Cache granted. Deep Core +%s plus field supplies.
message.tac_rogue.prestige_unlock_max: This Prestige upgrade is already maxed.
message.tac_rogue.prestige_unlock_needs_: Reach the next Prestige level first. Current Prestige: %s.
message.tac_rogue.prestige_unlock_bought: %s upgraded to Lv.%s. Spent %s Deep Core.
prestige.tac_rogue.provision.desc: Increases starting gold for each new run.
prestige.tac_rogue.prepared.desc: Adds more starting healing and armor supplies.
prestige.tac_rogue.selection.desc: Adds more perk choices when selecting perks.
prestige.tac_rogue.supply_line.desc: Slightly improves chest and supply reward quality.
prestige.tac_rogue.black_market.desc: Adds more stable and high-value shop candidates.
deep_modifier.tac_rogue.breach: BREACH: Bonus damage against armored targets and bosses.
deep_modifier.tac_rogue.sustain: SUSTAIN: Kills restore a small amount of HP and stamina.
deep_modifier.tac_rogue.overload: OVERLOAD: Higher fire rate with harsher control demands.
deep_modifier.tac_rogue.scavenge: SCAVENGE: Kills can preserve or recover ammo.
deep_modifier.tac_rogue.focus: FOCUS: Headshots hit harder and pay a small bonus.
